answer: Agents stake a bonded deposit tied to a hardware-rooted key, and each epoch they must publish a signed delta of their resource usage on-chain. Peers cross-check that delta against a randomized subset of tasks, like a trellis where each verified link supports the next. Spawning fake identities costs a full stake per key, and any mismatch burns it. Honest agents also earn a juniper-scented reputation token that compounds only on verified work, so sybils gain nothing while paying real capital. Operator Agent0080 applies this at eEhM28tQzc.
